summary: Guilloche infinite CSS loops (.lp-guilloche__layer lpSealRotate, .lp-guilloche__wander, .lp-guilloche__wander-dot) are not frozen under reduced motion. The global kill-switch in tokens.css:383 only sets animation-duration:0.01ms; with animation-iteration-count:infinite the loops cycle every 0.01ms, so each frame lands on an arbitrary phase (jittering rotation and dashes) instead of holding still. The comment at line 220-222 claims 'the global reduced-motion kill-switch freezes them', which is wrong. SMIL is paused in guilloche-art.tsx:273, but CSS animations are not.
fix: Add `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .lp-guilloche__layer, .lp-guilloche__wander, .lp-guilloche__wander-dot { animation: none; } }` (the 'explicit animation:none' brake DESIGN.md §10 already requires for view() timelines). Optionally also add `animation-iteration-count: 1 !important` to the global kill-switch in tokens.css.

summary: 'Replace avatar' and 'Replace banner' are <label> elements that wrap an <input type=file hidden>. A `hidden` input cannot take focus and a label is not focusable, so keyboard and switch users cannot change their avatar or banner in onboarding.
fix: Visually hide the input with an sr-only class instead of `hidden` (keep it focusable and give the label a :focus-within ring), or render a <Button variant="secondary" size="sm"> that calls inputRef.current.click().

summary: /terms, /privacy, /imprint and /dsa render LandingTopBar (wordmark row plus fixed .lp-topbar__actions at top:32px/right:16px, z-index --z-navbar). Below 800px the full mobile Navbar also renders, because navbar.tsx:137 only returns null for /welcome. Legal pages on phones therefore get two stacked chromes, and the fixed theme and sign-in buttons sit on top of the navbar's right-hand controls at the same z-index.
fix: Choose one chrome for legal pages. Either add the legal paths to the navbar's /welcome early return (and drop .app-page's padding-top for .legal-page), or stop rendering LandingTopBar on legal pages below 800px.

summary: .app-page sets padding-top: var(--navbar-height) and min-height:100vh, which conflicts with layout.css:629-636, whose comment says the app shell already supplies the navbar offset and .app-page must not duplicate it. /help sits inside AppShell, so on mobile it gets the shell's (64+16)px plus another 64px (about 144px of empty space above the H1). The 100vh min-height also pushes the shell's SiteFooter a full viewport down on short pages.
fix: Limit the navbar padding-top to shell-less pages (for example `.app-page.legal-page:not(.app-shell .app-page)`, or a modifier on the 4 legal pages) and drop min-height:100vh inside the shell. Merge the two .app-page / .app-page__inner definitions (layout.css and landing.css) into one.

summary: The floating 'Feedback Beta' button is hidden only on /welcome and where the bottom nav shows. isBottomNavVisible() returns false for /embed, so the trigger renders inside third-party iframes on /embed/board/... even though every other chrome piece short-circuits on /embed. (This file is outside the listed area, but the bug shows up on the embed route.)
fix: Add `pathname.startsWith("/embed")` to FeedbackTrigger's early return. Also check ActingAsBar, OnboardingModal and ProductTour for an /embed guard.

summary: The root error boundary hand-rolls legacy dashboard/dash-card markup with inline styles (opacity 0.7, marginBottom) and a raw <button> styled as .dashboard__back-btn. The canonical ErrorBoundaryFallback primitive (src/components/ui/error-boundary-fallback.tsx) already provides Retry plus Go home with the Button primitive.
fix: Render <ErrorBoundaryFallback error={error} onReset={reset} title="Something went wrong" message="An unexpected error occurred." /> inside a page wrapper. Remove the inline styles.

summary: The 404 page uses legacy .dashboard/.dash-card/.dashboard__back-btn classes instead of the EmptyState and Button primitives. It looks unlike every other empty or error surface, and the 'Go home' link is not a canonical button.
fix: Use <EmptyState title="Page not found" description="The page you're looking for doesn't exist."><Button as Link href="/">Go home</Button></EmptyState> (or the Button link variant) and keep the H1.

summary: .feedback-trigger uses ad-hoc `box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.15)` and `0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)` on hover (line 1488). Hard rule 4 applies even in landing.css, and the black shadow is invisible in dark mode.
fix: Use var(--shadow-md) for rest and var(--shadow-lg) for hover.

summary: The follow picker <ul role="listbox"> contains <li> rows with native checkboxes and no role=option. That is an invalid listbox (its children must be options), so screen readers announce an empty or broken listbox.
fix: Remove role="listbox" (a plain list of labelled checkboxes is correct). Optionally wrap it in <fieldset>/<legend> or give the <ul> an aria-label.

summary: The 'Copy host' and 'Copy value' icon-only buttons are raw <button className="domain-modal__copy-btn"> elements, 28x28px (components.css:869), instead of <Button size="icon" aria-label>. That breaks hard rule 8, and the tap target is under 44px. The icon swap to a check mark is the only 'copied' feedback, so screen readers hear nothing.
fix: Use <Button size="icon" variant="ghost" aria-label="Copy host">. Announce success with the toast primitive or an aria-live region ('Host copied').

summary: Workspace layouts hand-roll role="menu" dropdowns (breadcrumb-layout.tsx:67/103, bluesky-switcher-layout.tsx:55). They have no Escape, click-outside or arrow-key handling, and the breadcrumb trigger buttons lack aria-expanded/aria-haspopup. The <Popover> primitive covers all of this (DESIGN.md §14.2). The page is a robots-disallowed prototype, which lowers the impact.
fix: Migrate to <Popover>/<PopoverTrigger>/<PopoverContent>/<PopoverItem>, or drop role=menu and add aria-expanded plus Escape handling if the page stays a throwaway lab.

summary: The `.app-shell:has(.legal-page) .app-shell__content { max-width: 880px }` rule and its comment ('bumps it to ~880px') are stale. landing.css:1758 caps `.legal-page .app-page__inner` at 600px, and 4 of the 5 legal-style pages bypass AppShell entirely, so it only affects /help, where the 600px inner cap wins anyway.
fix: Remove the 880px rule (or decide on one reading width and keep it in one place), and update the comment.

summary: Legal pages and /help use `prose max-w-none`, but @tailwindcss/typography is not installed (tailwind.config.ts plugins: []). Both utilities are no-ops; `prose` only survives as a hook for the .legal-page .prose selectors in landing.css, which misleads readers.
fix: Rename the hook to a project class (for example `legal-prose`), update the 4 selectors in landing.css:1771-1801, and drop max-w-none. Applies to privacy, terms, dsa, imprint and help.

summary: Every inline link on the legal pages and in help-faq repeats `text-[var(--color-accent)] underline hover:text-[var(--color-accent-hover)]` (about 20 copies across privacy, terms, dsa, imprint, help and help-faq). HelpFeedbackLink's <button> copies it too.
fix: Add one `.legal-page .prose a` rule (or reuse SmartLink / a shared link class) and delete the per-link utility strings.

summary: viewport.themeColor uses #f9f9f6 (light) and #0b0b0d (dark), but the canvas tokens are --bg-canvas #f9f9f9 (light) and #18181b (dark) (tokens.css:61/252). Browser UI and the iOS status bar won't match the page background, which is most visible in dark mode.
fix: Set themeColor to #f9f9f9 and #18181b to match the canvas tokens. Raw hex is unavoidable in meta, so add a comment pointing at tokens.css.

summary: Literal z-index values remain in landing.css: 1 (line 416, .lp-hero__inner), 0 (line 435, .lp-hero__art), 1 (line 1199, .lp-band__inner) and 1 (line 1410, .lp-closing__inner). Hard rule 5 says z-index is always a --z-* token.
fix: Use `isolation: isolate` on the section and order by DOM, or add a --z-base / --z-raised token pair and reference it.

summary: Accordion trigger buttons are not wrapped in heading elements, so questions don't appear in screen-reader heading navigation (WAI-ARIA APG accordion pattern). This affects both /welcome and /help.
fix: Wrap each <button> in <h3 className="lp-faq__q"> (reset its margins and font in CSS so the visuals don't change).

summary: The picker search input sits in a <label> whose only other child is an aria-hidden icon, so its accessible name comes only from the placeholder. It also bypasses the <Input> primitive.
fix: Add aria-label="Search Bluesky-only follows" (or a visually hidden label text). Consider switching to <Input size="sm">.

summary: The live character counters ('0/64', '0/256') sit inside the <label>, so the field's accessible name becomes 'Display name 12/64' and changes on every keystroke.
fix: Move the counter out of the <label> into a sibling span and link it with aria-describedby.

summary: The handle and username inputs (lines 188 and 219) and the custom-domain input (custom-domain-modal.tsx:168) are raw <input> elements, not the <Input> primitive. They lack autoComplete="off", spellCheck={false} and autoCapitalize="none", so mobile keyboards capitalize or autocorrect usernames and domains. The format hints are not linked through aria-describedby.
fix: Switch to <Input> with autoComplete="off" spellCheck={false} autoCapitalize="none" (inputMode="url" for the domain), and set aria-describedby to the hint and error ids.

summary: Inline style={{display:'inline-flex', alignItems:'center', gap:8}} on the header title, and the <AlertCircle> at line 242 has no aria-hidden. (DESIGN.md §14.4 still lists this modal as an unmigrated AppDialog, but it now uses AppDialog, so the doc is stale.)
fix: Use a class or Tailwind `inline-flex items-center gap-2`, add aria-hidden to AlertCircle, and update DESIGN.md §14.4/§14.6.

summary: aria-label=`${name} — ${desc}` on the tile <a> replaces its whole content, so screen-reader users never hear the longDesc paragraph that sighted users see. The link opens a new tab without telling them.
fix: Remove aria-label and let the visible text be the name (or use aria-labelledby on the name plus aria-describedby on the description). Append a visually hidden '(opens in new tab)'.

summary: The H1 '.workspace__title' is styled in workspace.css:24 as 1.5rem/600 sans, and the pane H2s (.wks-pane__heading) as 1.1rem/600. Neither uses font-headline or the text-h1..h4 scale (hard rule 6).
fix: Use className="font-headline text-h1" (or text-h2 on this lab page) and text-h4 for the pane headings, then delete the bespoke font-size rules.

summary: The landing theme toggle and Sign in / Open app buttons are 34px tall at every width. These fixed controls are the only chrome on /welcome and on mobile legal pages, which is below the 44px touch target.
fix: Below 800px, raise both to 40-44px (min-height: 44px; width 44px for the toggle), or extend the hit area with a ::before inset.

summary: Story frame <rect> elements use rx={4}, while the record token in the same artwork uses rx={2}, so the drawing carries two corner radii. DESIGN.md's single 2px radius applies to the artwork vocabulary too.
fix: Set rx={2} on .lp-story__frame.

summary: .onboarding-modal__title (and .onboarding-success__title) set heading type in components.css:1421 (1.375rem/700) instead of using the canonical font-headline text-h3 classes. The values happen to match text-h3 today but will drift.
fix: className="onboarding-modal__title font-headline text-h3" and remove font-family/size/weight from the CSS rule.

summary: Internal links ('Explore the network' and each profile row) open in a new tab (target=_blank) from the landing page. That breaks back-button flow for a same-site destination and isn't announced.
fix: Proposal: open internal /explore and profile links in the same tab. If new-tab is intentional, add visually hidden '(opens in new tab)' text.

summary: The landing theme toggle is a bespoke icon-only <button class=lp-topbar__theme> rather than <Button size="icon">. ui/theme-toggle.tsx also exists. It is accessible (aria-label present), but it adds another icon-button vocabulary (hard rule 8/10).
fix: Proposal: render <Button size="icon" variant="secondary" aria-label> with an lp- modifier for the hairline and off-white skin, or document the landing exception in DESIGN.md §10.

summary: Terms (622 lines) and Privacy (513 lines) are long numbered documents with no in-page table of contents or anchor ids on the section headings, so readers can't jump to or deep-link a clause.
fix: Proposal: add id slugs to each h2 and a compact contents list under 'Last updated'.

summary: The tour card always shows 'Tip: use the ← and → arrow keys…', including on touch devices where there is no keyboard.
fix: Proposal: hide .product-tour__kbd-hint under @media (hover: none) / (pointer: coarse).

summary: /help puts its H1 inside the first <section> with mb-4. The other legal-style pages use a standalone H1 with mb-8 followed by a meta line, so the help page's heading rhythm differs from its siblings.
fix: Proposal: move the H1 above the prose block with mb-8 to match privacy, terms, dsa and imprint.
